احرنفزت (form IIIq)

# اِحْرَنْفَزْتَ (iḥranfazta) /iħ.ran.faz.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْرَنْفَزَ (iḥranfaza)
# اِحْرَنْفَزْتِ (iḥranfazti) /iħ.ran.faz.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْرَنْفَزَ (iḥranfaza)
# اِحْرَنْفَزَتْ (iḥranfazat) /i
